title: Thanks a Million
body:
We are living in unprecedented times. Zot Chanukah is the day of the final sealing of the decree for the new year, 5781. The Jewish people needs these Tehillim to turn the decree over for the best! What would you have done last year to stop Corona in its tracks last Chanukah? We don't know what is hanging over our heads!

 

Even more than that – come start thanking Hashem and join me in Heaven on Earth! You can’t imagine the sweet life that is thanking Hashem, and the miracles that await you! 

 

The One Million Campaign 

I want the Jewish people, and everyone, around the world to join me to say 1 million Psalm 100, Mizmor L’Todah through the end of Chanukah! 

 

We can get there a lot easier than you think – if we do it together! 

 

How many Psalm 100 can you say a day, from TODAY – whenever you read this article – through and including Zot Chanukah (Friday Dec. 18, 2020, before sunset wherever you live)? 

 

For instance, I the Editor have taken upon myself to say 10 Mizmor L’Todah a day. For me, that’s about 10 minutes. From today, Sun. Nov 29, through Zot Chanukah, is exactly 20 days. 10 x 20 = 200 Psalm 100 that I am taking upon myself, to help us get to 1 million! Even if you can only do one a day, that still adds up to 20! 

 

It's so easy to join! Just email rachel.avrahami@breslev.co.il with how many a day you can say to get them added to the total – or comment at the bottom of this article!

 

 

Even if you don’t feel comfortable taking upon yourself a set amount a day, that’s okay too – just do whatever you can! Either way, make yourself a reminder and say as many as you can every day! 

 

Even more important – share this campaign with everyone! 

It isn’t up to you to say them all yourself – it IS up to you to help get more people to say them too!  

 

Click here to read more about the Deeper Meaning of Psalm 100 and important things to have in mind while you're saying it!

 

You might also be interested in: 
 

  • – Say Thank You and See Miracles 

  • – The Gift Whose Name is Thank You (English book or Hebrew CD) 

  • – Chok Todah – The Law of Gratitude booklet. Can’t wait? Read the article all about the Law of Thank You.

 

 

Just in the first few hours of this campaign, the English group is already up to 16 participants saying 1,400 Psalm 100!  

The Editor will continue to update this article as more people join!
